title: Label the two paragraphs of a note in Notes

source.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0; ported by reference (our own instruction, note text, setup and checks; no source text copied)
source.changes: Instruction and the seeded article are our own: the source's article text is not copied, so the article is a param of two short articles we wrote (the source's own can't be a pick). The note's title carries the run's nonce. The source deleted every note on the Mac before seeding; here setup only removes notes with this run's title and makes one note, and teardown deletes it. The source's check grepped all notes' HTML for the labels and paragraphs in order; ours reads this note's plain text and wants exactly the title, label 1, paragraph 1, label 2, paragraph 2 (blank lines ignored).

pick.title: Lighthouse Keepers
pick.p1: Before lamps were automated, every lighthouse on the coast needed a keeper who climbed the tower each evening to light it. The work was lonely, and supplies often came by boat only once a month.
pick.p2: Keepers wrote careful logbooks of the weather, the passing ships and every repair they made. Many of these books survive, and they give historians a clear picture of daily life at the edge of the sea.

pick.title: Night Trains
pick.p1: Night trains once linked most large cities in Europe, letting travellers sleep through long journeys and wake up where they were going. Cheap flights later took many of their passengers away.
pick.p2: In recent years several routes have come back, helped by travellers who would rather not fly. Operators have bought new sleeping cars with small private cabins and showers.

setup.why: No note of this title is left from an earlier try, in Recently Deleted either.
Make the note: the title as a heading, then an empty line before each of the two paragraphs.

instruction: In Notes there is a note called "{{art.title}} {{nonce}}" with two paragraphs, each after an empty line. Label the paragraphs: type "Paragraph 1" in the empty line before the first paragraph and "Paragraph 2" in the empty line before the second. Leave the paragraphs themselves as they are.

checks.why: Exactly one live note has the title, and its non-empty lines, read from its plain text, are the title, Paragraph 1, the first paragraph, Paragraph 2 and the second paragraph, in that order and unchanged. After setup the labels are missing, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Delete the note, and again from Recently Deleted.

oracle.why: Write the two labels into the empty lines of the note.
